H01.description: Untrusted agent-authored decision rows are only partly sanitised: C1 controls are not reliably flattened and < and > pass through, so markup such as <script> reaches the TSV, JSON and INDEX.md output.

H02.description: Any --file target is treated as a fixture and returns before the CI/hook check, so naming the live ledger or a pending file by path writes it from CI, a hook or a linked worktree.

H03.description: import never checks --rewrite targets, so it rewrites files outside the project, through '..' paths or symlinks, and fails on missing files only after the ledger has been written.

H04.description: Doc sentence updated to say pacing is unset by default, to match the config example fix.

H05.description: Comment reworded to say pacing is unset by default.

H06.description: Comment reworded to describe the unset default.

H07.description: The example sets pacing: rounds explicitly, and an explicit value wins, so a copied config makes minimal mode use rounds instead of its documented batch default.

H08.description: Adds regression tests for multi-value blocks, escape ids, id pattern, oversize blocks and large transcripts.

H09.description: Adds tests that --file naming the live or pending ledger is refused under CI and in worktrees.

H10.description: Adds tests for --rewrite target validation in import.

H11.description: Adds a test that hostile decision row text is cleaned in all outputs.

H12.description: Removes the regex/exempt variables and rewrites the header comment for the awk-based check in H13.

H13.description: The operative-reference check drops any line containing an exempt word anywhere (e.g. 'Run /alpha on the operator's behalf'), so operative invocations go unreported; this is an invariant-check helper in a test file, so the defect is in the guard rather than shipped code.

H14.description: Adds a fixture test that an exempt word only exempts when it precedes the verb.

H15.description: Sets up the temp work dir, block size limit and id pattern used by the H16 fix.

H16.description: Block contents and the accumulated rounds go to jq as argv strings, so transcripts over the 128 KiB argument limit crash; jq -e also accepts a block holding two JSON values and does not validate id characters.

H17.description: The violation message now includes the per-block malformed reason from H16.

H18.description: The human-readable report prints ids and violation text unescaped, so control characters such as ESC from untrusted transcript ids reach the terminal.

I01.description: Documents LOA_PROFILE_CONFIG_FILE for a later profile feature; unrelated to this change's hunks.

I05.description: A silent profile-lib.sh source failure, introduced by the later cycle-129 profile knob; not shown at head.
